oracle_classification.AVAILABLE_REPRODUCIBLE: tool, pinned image and invocation are recorded and the affine deck replay is reproducible
oracle_classification.AVAILABLE_LOCAL_ONLY: tool is reachable in this workstation environment but is not an installed/CI dependency
oracle_classification.AVAILABLE_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE: tool can be invoked but version, inputs or outputs cannot be replayed deterministically
oracle_classification.UNAVAILABLE: no executable or usable pinned image is available

oracles.local_observation: Docker daemon and image available; host ccx executable not installed
oracles.license_or_restriction: open-source external tool; image availability is environment-dependent
oracles.determinism: deck replay required; no QF correlation is implied by deck execution
oracles.integration: two integration points, as documented by CalculiX
oracles.mesh_and_results: same physical mesh and nodal displacement/reaction outputs are preferred; stress output requires sampling contract

oracles.local_observation: Pinned base image and locally built derived headless image expose Code_Aster 18.1.0; host as_run executable is not installed
oracles.license_or_restriction: availability and version must be supplied by the execution environment
oracles.determinism: single-thread deck replay required; no QF correlation is implied by deck execution
oracles.integration: mechanical 3D modelisation and exact quadrature behavior must be recorded from the executed version
oracles.mesh_and_results: PENTA6 mesh and minimal MECA_STATIQUE deck are executed as a bounded affine correlation; pressure, refinement and distorted correlations remain unclaimed

comparability_contract.geometry: identical affine prism coordinates; physical dimensions recorded per case
comparability_contract.material: homogeneous isotropic linear elastic, E and nu in SI units
comparability_contract.mesh: identical coordinates/connectivity or an explicit physical-equivalence map with digest
comparability_contract.node_order: mapping.json; identity map is only valid after orientation and affine replay checks
comparability_contract.boundary_conditions: named node sets and DOF components, with the same constrained DOFs
comparability_contract.loads: nodal loads or face tractions with total resultant and sign recorded
comparability_contract.integration: external rule/version recorded; never inferred from a matching result
comparability_contract.stress_rule: compare only identical stress measure and integration/sample location; otherwise NOT_COMPARABLE
comparability_contract.units: SI units unless a case explicitly records another unit system
comparability_contract.sign_convention: positive outward normal and positive applied load are recorded per deck; reactions use the solver sign convention and are compared after explicit normalization

tolerance_policy.near_zero: use a declared absolute reference scale or classify NOT_COMPARABLE; never divide by a near-zero reference
tolerance_policy.post_observation_retuning: FORBIDDEN; changing a tolerance after a QF result invalidates the initial verdict

comparability_contract.stress_comparability: same measure, same sample point, same frame and same sign convention; otherwise NOT_COMPARABLE
comparability_contract.skip_policy: unavailable, non-reproducible or non-comparable external runs are explicit SKIPPED_EXTERNAL_UNAVAILABLE or NOT_FORMULATION_COMPATIBLE and never PASS
